$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 longer-Windows bug-hunting plan — 3-run claude+copilot variant of longer_mac_bug_hunt_plan.json. Drops the codex Mode B sidekiq row because codex Mode B has historically been fragile on Windows (Ruby toolchain + Mode B's per-phase exec pattern surfaces Windows path/encoding issues). Runs the same tokio (opus) + webpack (copilot npm) + Newtonsoft.Json (copilot pip) on Windows to validate the v1.5.7 174 manifest-based pool model and the Phase 8 docstring cleanup across the cross-platform install paths. Branch refs confirmed via git ls-remote on 2026-05-31: tokio=master, webpack=main, Newtonsoft.Json=master. Concurrency: pool={claude:1, copilot:2} — all 3 run in parallel; ~30-50 min wall clock bounded by claude/opus on tokio. Pre-flight: on Windows, ensure (a) git, (b) python 3.10+, (c) node + npm for the npm-local-tgz row, (d) the QPB clone is at branch 1.5.7 HEAD, and (e) the claude / copilot CLIs are installed + authenticated.

runs.description: Row 0 — claude/opus reviews tokio (Rust async runtime, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 0. Tests pip-local-wheel install on Windows + cross-platform tokio review.

Row 1 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews webpack (JavaScript module bundler, ref=main) via npm-local-tgz (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 1. Tests the npm-local-tgz (npx --yes --prefer-offline) install path on Windows; this is the install path most likely to surface Windows-specific issues if any remain.

Row 2 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews Newtonsoft.Json (C# JSON serializer, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 2. C# repo on Windows is a natural fit; tests pip-local-wheel on Windows + a Mode A run on a non-main ref via the post-177 BUG-010 fix path.
